description:
Decide whether `jit claim acquire` appends `IssueClaimed` from the issue record's assignee alone, so a claim parses no event-log record.

## Background

`jit claim acquire` synchronizes the issue through `MutationIntent::ClaimIssue` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:170-212`). Its capture requests the whole event log (`:189-197`). The finalizer parses it (`captured_events`, `repository_state/mutation.rs:675-688`) and asks whether the log's tail already shows this claim (`event_tail_reflects_claim`, `:693-708`) before deciding at `:851-888`. Acquire, unassign, acquire again therefore reassigns the issue with no event, and an issue assigned outside jit gets a repair event. Every event append already reads only the log's bounded end (`CaptureSpec::discover_tail`, `repository_state/image.rs:581-589`), and the issue write and its events publish in one redo record. Tests asserting today's rule: `mutation.rs:2021-2160`, `commands/claim.rs:1780-1830`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `claim acquire` captures the issue record and the log's tail only. It appends `IssueClaimed` exactly when the captured issue's assignee differs from the claimant, in the same redo record as the issue write, and appends nothing otherwise.
- [hard] REQ-02: `captured_events` and `event_tail_reflects_claim` no longer exist, and the claim decision reads no event-log record.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests show that acquire, unassign, acquire appends two claim events; that a repeated claim appends nothing; and that a claim of an issue already assigned to the claimant outside jit appends nothing.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
- This reverses the earlier rule that a claim repairs a missing claim event for an assignment made outside jit.
title: Claim acquire emits its event exactly when the assignee changes
